extensionAttribute.description: Returns the installed Sassafras K2 KeyAccess client version, or "Not Installed".
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Sassafras K2 KeyAccess Client Version Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
plist="/Library/KeyAccess/KeyAccess.app/Contents/Info.plist"
if [[ -f "$plist" ]]; then version=$(/usr/bin/defaults read "$plist" CFBundleShortVersionString 2>/dev/null) echo "<result>${version:-Unknown}</result>" else echo "<result>Not Installed</result>" fi
